definitions.explanation: The time at three hours past midnight or noon.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}は{三時|さんじ}からです。
examples.english: The meeting starts at three o'clock.

examples.japanese: {午後|ごご}{三時|さんじ}にお{茶|ちゃ}を{飲|の}むのが{習慣|しゅうかん}です。
examples.english: It's my habit to have tea at three in the afternoon.

notes:
In Japan, {三時|さんじ} in the afternoon is traditionally associated with snack time ({三時|さんじ}のおやつ).

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{午前|ごぜん}{三時|さんじ} (3 a.m.)
・{午後|ごご}{三時|さんじ} (3 p.m.)
・{三時半|さんじはん} (3:30)
・{三時|さんじ}のおやつ (afternoon snack at three)
